value.rationale: The construction is a directly motivated benchmark for the original 2011 volume-ratio shadow-hiding problem. The all-dimensional strict optimizer theorem, first four-dimensional algebraic sharp benchmark, and sharp n^-2 decay law explain a previously unquantified limitation of the classical family, with future value for comparing any stronger constructions. No claim of global shadow-covering optimality or paper-sized advances.
